svg.title: Quantum contracts: ownership and compatibility
svg.desc: Intended small provider-neutral records connect authoritative upstream meaning with numerical, hardware and evidence consumers. Dependency arrows point from consumers towards contracts. The current domain inventory is empty; implemented repository inventory tooling is separate. Complete field meaning, explicit refusal, installed round trips, qualified generation and no-loss migration remain required. This is an architecture explanation, not a deployed integration or scientific result.

g.text: ANULUM / QUANTUM COMPUTING SYSTEMS
Quantum contracts: ownership and compatibility
In progress · source reading 2026-10-20 · domain contracts and installed consumer qualification remain open
1 / THE DOMAIN ARCHITECTURE — INTENDED RESPONSIBILITIES
Authoritative upstream meaning
Actual schema owner and namespace come first
Retain existing evidence-manifest ownership
Every field, unit, shape and refusal state is explicit
The workbench keeps its established behaviour
Small versioned contract layer
Provider-neutral parameter / result boundaries
No solvers, SDKs or Studio code as dependencies
Complete version and source-reference semantics
Target architecture; no domain schemas yet
CONSUMERS DEPEND ON CONTRACTS
Numerical consumers
Original parameters and results
Units, shapes and precision
Real installed round trips
Hardware abstraction
Actual provider-neutral records
Explicit absence and refusal
No hidden provider execution
Evidence / public consumers
Original semantic qualification
Upstream evidence stays owned
Studio presentation stays separate
Admission must preserve the complete meaning
Received records are data; installed caller-owned code retains executable authority.
Unknown versions, malformed references, duplicate keys and wrong units / shapes need locating refusals.
Absent values never become zero. Integrity, authentic origin and scientific correctness remain separate.
2 / WHAT EXISTS TODAY — REPOSITORY TOOLING, SEPARATE FROM DOMAIN CONTRACTS
Actual current domain inventory
evidence_maturity: architecture_only
capabilities: [] claims: [] schema_files: []
Maintained Python roots: tools and tests
Inventory format 1 is not a quantum wire version
Implemented inventory checker
Bounded manifest; reject duplicate / unknown fields
Bind actual source roots to native configuration
Reconcile declared and actual schema population
Return fingerprints and scoped CLI outcomes
3 / REQUIRED BEFORE DOMAIN AND CONSUMER ACCEPTANCE
Upstream owners freeze full record meaning with actual producers and consumers.
Native maintainers reproduce generated interfaces and applicable language parity.
Installed round trips exercise complete records, malformed inputs and version skew.
Independent validation establishes no-loss workbench migration and real failure / rollback behaviour.
These are needed contributor roles and acceptance obligations, not confirmed partners or acquired equipment.
This diagram adds no executable dependency, procurement figure, released schema or scientific result.
Original source readings retain their own dates; source-owner work and whole Foundation acceptance remain open.
No source-project gate / contract / quantum experiment run · source-owner, consumer and publication review pending
